paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R Part Type: Fuel line retaining kit Part Number: 20-0560

The Radium Engineering Fuel Line Retaining Kit allows up to two aftermarket fuel lines to be run under the R35 GT-R, routing the hoses in a channel separate from the OEM fuel and brake lines. The retainers are typically installed under the right-hand side of the vehicle but can also be fitted under the left-hand side.
hl: Two Lines: Supports up to 2 aftermarket fuel lines
Separate Channel: Keeps new lines clear of the OEM fuel and brake lines
No Drilling: Uses five OEM threaded holes and OEM hardware
Large Hose Capacity: Maximum hose OD of 22.6mm (0.89in)
Either Side: Installs under the RH or LH side of the vehicle
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Line Retaining Kit for Nissan GT-R R35
